helpline_1930.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
helpline_1930.description: Toll-free national citizen helpline for reporting financial cyber fraud and initiating beneficiary account freezing under CFCFRMS.

ncrp_portal.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
ncrp_portal.description: Official national web portal for lodging formal cyber crime complaints and tracking police acknowledgment numbers.

emergency_112.name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
emergency_112.description: All-India unified emergency response number for urgent police dispatch and assistance.

rbi_sachet.name: RBI Sachet Portal
rbi_sachet.description: Official platform to report illegal deposit collection, unauthorized digital lending apps, and unregistered financial entities.

rbi_cms.name: RBI Complaint Management System (Banking Ombudsman)
rbi_cms.description: Escalation platform for unresolved banking fraud grievances when the bank fails to respond satisfactorily within 30 days.

dot_chakshu.name: DoT Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi)
dot_chakshu.description: Facility to report suspected fraudulent SMS, international spoofed calls, and malicious WhatsApp communication.
